
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/swizard/p/19382222" title="发布于 2025-12-22 14:21">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Python 并不慢，是你看不懂：拆解 CPython 虚拟机背后的魔法引擎</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3 data-path-to-node="4">1. 引言：你真的了解你的代码吗？</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="5"><strong data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="0">痛点场景</strong>： 你写了一行代码 <code data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="14">print("Hello World")</code>，按下回车，屏幕上立刻跳出了结果。一切顺滑得像魔法。 但只要面试官问一句：“这行代码在 CPU 里到底发生了什么？<code data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="91">.pyc</code> 文件是干嘛的？为什么 Python 有 GIL？” 90% 的开发者会卡壳。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="6">我们常说 Python 是“解释型语言”，慢是因为它“一边读源码一边执行”。<strong data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="38">这是一个巨大的误区！</strong></p>
<p data-path-to-node="7"><strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="0">解决方案</strong>： 实际上，你平时用的 Python（准确说是 <strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="28">CPython</strong>，官方默认实现），它的工作方式更像是一个精密的<strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="58">翻译官</strong>加一个勤劳的<strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="67">执行工</strong>。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="8">今天，我们要用一把手术刀，切开 Python 的外壳，看看这个由 C 语言编写的引擎——<strong data-path-to-node="8" data-index-in-node="44">CPython</strong>，是如何运转的。</p>
<hr data-path-to-node="9">
<h3 data-path-to-node="10">2. 概念拆解：米其林餐厅的秘密</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="11">如果把执行 Python 代码的过程比作<strong data-path-to-node="11" data-index-in-node="20">在米其林餐厅做一道菜</strong>，那么 CPython 的内部架构可以这样理解：</p>
<h4 data-path-to-node="12">生活化类比</h4>
<ol start="1" data-path-to-node="13">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">源码 (.py)</strong> = <strong data-path-to-node="13,0,0" data-index-in-node="11">主厨手写的原始菜谱</strong>。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="13,0,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,0,1,0,0">充满了各种复杂的句式、注释，只有人能看懂，机器（CPU）看着头疼。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">编译器 (Compiler)</strong> = <strong data-path-to-node="13,1,0" data-index-in-node="17">二厨（翻译官）</strong>。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="13,1,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,1,1,0,0">他的工作不是做菜，而是<strong data-path-to-node="13,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="11">整理菜谱</strong>。他把主厨手写的菜谱，翻译成一张张标准化的、极其简单的<strong data-path-to-node="13,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="42">工单（Bytecode）</strong>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,1,1,1,0">比如主厨写“把那只鸡炖了”，二厨会拆解成：“取锅 -&gt; 加水 -&gt; 开火 -&gt; 放鸡”。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">字节码 (.pyc / Bytecode)</strong> = <strong data-path-to-node="13,2,0" data-index-in-node="24">标准化工单</strong>。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="13,2,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,2,1,0,0">这是一组中间代码，它不再是给人看的，而是给机器看的。Python <strong data-path-to-node="13,2,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="33">从来不直接运行你的源码</strong>，它运行的永远是这些工单。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Python 虚拟机 (PVM)</strong> = <strong data-path-to-node="13,3,0" data-index-in-node="19">流水线工人</strong>。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="13,3,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="13,3,1,0,0">这是一个死板但执行力极强的工人（本质是一个用 C 语言写的巨大死循环）。他拿着工单，一行一行地读：“LOAD_NAME（拿锅）”、“call_function（做菜）”。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 data-path-to-node="14">核心图解：CPython 的流水线</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="15">下面这张图展示了从你的代码到最终执行的全过程：</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3513861865-467 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwiyucS49cqRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQoQc">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3513861865-467 ng-star-inserted"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1703/202512/1703-20251222142036430-637912796.png" alt="image"><br>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3513861865-467 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3513861865-467">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3513861865-467">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-path-to-node="17">
<h3 data-path-to-node="18">3. 动手实战：看见“隐形”的字节码</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="19">别光听我说，我们来“抓现行”。我们要用 Python 自带的神器 <code data-path-to-node="19" data-index-in-node="33">dis</code> (Disassembler) 模块，来看看你的代码被“二厨”翻译成了什么样。</p>
<h4 data-path-to-node="20">Hello World (MVP)</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="21">创建一个简单的函数，我们看看它在 CPython 眼里长什么样。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3513861865-468 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwiyucS49cqRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQogc">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3513861865-468 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3513861865-468">Python</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3513861865-468 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3513861865-468">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3513861865-468">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3513861865-468 highlighter-hljs"><code>import dis

def calculator(a, b):
    # 这是一个简单的加法
    result = a + b
    return result

# 见证奇迹的时刻：打印该函数的字节码
print(f"函数名: {calculator.__name__}")
dis.dis(calculator)</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h4 data-path-to-node="23">代码解析：读懂“天书”</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="24">运行上述代码，你会看到类似这样的输出（这就是 CPython 真正执行的东西）：</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3513861865-469 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwiyucS49cqRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQowc">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3513861865-469 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3513861865-469">Plaintext</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3513861865-469 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3513861865-469">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3513861865-469">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3513861865-469 highlighter-hljs"><code>  5           0 LOAD_FAST                0 (a)
              2 LOAD_FAST                1 (b)
              4 BINARY_ADD
              6 STORE_FAST               2 (result)

  6           8 LOAD_FAST                2 (result)
             10 RETURN_VALUE</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-path-to-node="26"><strong data-path-to-node="26" data-index-in-node="0">这是什么鬼？让我们逐行破译：</strong></p>
<ul data-path-to-node="27">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,0,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="27,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">LOAD_FAST 0 (a)</code></strong>:</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="27,0,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,0,1,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">含义</strong>：虚拟机（PVM）说：“把局部变量列表里第 0 号变量（也就是 <code data-path-to-node="27,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="34">a</code>）压入**栈（Stack）**顶。”</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,0,1,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Why</strong>：PVM 是基于<strong data-path-to-node="27,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="11">栈</strong>的虚拟机。想操作数据，必须先拿手里（压栈）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,1,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="27,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">LOAD_FAST 1 (b)</code></strong>:</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="27,1,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,1,1,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">含义</strong>：把变量 <code data-path-to-node="27,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="7">b</code> 压入栈顶。现在栈里有 <code data-path-to-node="27,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="20">[a, b]</code>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,2,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="27,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">BINARY_ADD</code></strong>:</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="27,2,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,2,1,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,2,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">含义</strong>：这是核心指令！PVM 看到这个，会弹出栈顶的两个元素（a 和 b），调用 C 语言底层的加法实现，算出结果，然后把结果扔回栈顶。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,3,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="27,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">STORE_FAST 2 (result)</code></strong>:</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="27,3,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,3,1,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,3,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">含义</strong>：把栈顶那个算好的结果拿走，存进局部变量 <code data-path-to-node="27,3,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="23">result</code> 里。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,4,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="27,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">RETURN_VALUE</code></strong>:</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="27,4,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="27,4,1,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="27,4,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">含义</strong>：把栈顶的值作为返回值抛出去，结束战斗。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-path-to-node="28"><strong data-path-to-node="28" data-index-in-node="0">结论</strong>：你以为你在写 Python，其实你在指挥 CPython 虚拟机搬运数据（压栈、出栈、运算）。</p>
<hr data-path-to-node="29">
<h3 data-path-to-node="30">4. 进阶深潜：GIL 与 内存管理的真相</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="31">既然都拆到这一步了，我们必须聊聊两个绕不开的话题。</p>
<h4 data-path-to-node="32">1. 为什么说 Python 线程是“假”的？（GIL）</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="33">在 CPython 虚拟机里，为了防止多个线程同时争抢内存导致数据混乱，C 语言层面加了一把超级大锁——<strong data-path-to-node="33" data-index-in-node="52">GIL (Global Interpreter Lock)</strong>。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="34">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="34,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="34,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">类比</strong>：回到我们的厨房。虽然你有 4 个炉灶（多核 CPU），但厨房规定：<strong data-path-to-node="34,0,0" data-index-in-node="36">同一时间只能有一个人拿锅铲（GIL）</strong>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="34,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="34,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">后果</strong>：无论你开了多少个线程，只要他们在执行 Python 字节码，同一时刻就只有一个 CPU 核心在工作。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="34,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="34,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">破解</strong>：对于计算密集型任务（如视频处理、机器学习），请使用 <code data-path-to-node="34,2,0" data-index-in-node="29">Multiprocessing</code>（多开几个厨房）或者调用 C/C++ 扩展（绕过锅铲限制）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-path-to-node="35">2. 垃圾回收（Garbage Collection）</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="36">你从未手动释放过内存，为什么 Python 不会内存泄露？因为 CPython 给每个对象都挂了一个“计数器”。</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="37">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="37,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">引用计数</strong>：</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="37,0,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,0,1,0,0">当你 <code data-path-to-node="37,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="3">x = [1, 2]</code>，这个列表头上的计数器变为 1。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,0,1,1,0">当你 <code data-path-to-node="37,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="3">y = x</code>，计数器变为 2。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,0,1,2,0">当你 <code data-path-to-node="37,0,1,2,0" data-index-in-node="3">del x</code>，计数器变回 1。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,0,1,3,0">当你 <code data-path-to-node="37,0,1,3,0" data-index-in-node="3">del y</code>，计数器归 0 -&gt; <strong data-path-to-node="37,0,1,3,0" data-index-in-node="19">CPython 立刻回收内存</strong>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="37,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="37,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">最佳实践</strong>：虽然有自动回收，但对于打开的文件、数据库连接，<strong data-path-to-node="37,1,0" data-index-in-node="28">必须</strong>使用 <code data-path-to-node="37,1,0" data-index-in-node="33">with</code> 语句（Context Manager），确保资源在使用后被正确关闭，不要过度依赖 GC。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-path-to-node="38">
<h3 data-path-to-node="39">5. 总结与延伸</h3>
<h4 data-path-to-node="40">核心总结</h4>
<p data-path-to-node="41">CPython 不是黑魔法，它只是一个<strong data-path-to-node="41" data-index-in-node="19">由 C 语言编写的程序</strong>。它包含两个核心步骤：</p>
<ol start="1" data-path-to-node="42">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="42,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="42,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">编译</strong>：将源码翻译成字节码（Bytecode）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="42,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="42,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">解释</strong>：通过一个巨大的循环（虚拟机）一条条执行字节码，操纵数值栈。</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
